name: VIX-stress + uncrowded-funding cross-domain bottom — buy the macro panic the crypto crowd has flushed
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (a CROSS-DOMAIN confluence distinct from macro-vix-spike-capitulation [VIX only] and funding-reset-reversion [funding+RSI]; here a MACRO panic gauge and a CRYPTO-NATIVE leverage gauge must agree): the strongest mean-reversion setup is a macro-driven panic (equity VIX spiking — exogenous, broad risk-off) that has ALSO flushed crypto's own leverage (funding at/below zero — the crypto longs have been liquidated, not still stacked). When BOTH are true the sell-off is a forced, cross-asset deleveraging into exhaustion rather than a crypto-specific blow-off with longs still trapped — historically the highest-conviction bounce. VIX (equity options panic) and funding (crypto perp leverage) are causally independent crowding reads, so requiring both is genuine confirmation, not a double-count. The two-sided test is also a leak guard: a VIX spike with crypto funding STILL positive means the crypto crowd hasn't capitulated and the bounce is premature. Entry: vix_level above a fitted panic floor AND funding_rate below a fitted uncrowded ceiling (crypto leverage flushed) AND price not in freefall (trend floor). Exit: vix_level crosses down through a calm threshold (macro panic relieved) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if vix_level ALONE (macro-vix-spike-capitulation) does as well, the funding leg is redundant. Disconfirmer 2: if an unconditional dip-buy matches the deflated Sharpe, neither gauge adds anything. Disconfirmer 3: VIX-panic windows are rare — the AND may fail the gate's min-trades floor, which is honest evidence not a bug. Disconfirmer 4 (cost): must clear ~20bps round-trip net. tier0 macro + tier0 funding features.
catalyst: an equity VIX panic that has ALSO flushed crypto leverage (funding flat/negative) — a cross-domain exhaustion bottom
